caption: A balloon on a string turns slowly in an elevator with mirrored walls, and its reflections turn with it in every wall.

sa.check: A balloon on a string turns slowly in an elevator.
Its reflections turn with it in every wall.
All the reflections move at the same instant.
Each reflection is mirrored relative to its wall.

pc.expect: All reflections move at the same instant as the balloon.
pc.fail: A reflection lags; or one turns while the balloon is still; or one stays still while the balloon turns.

pc.expect: Each reflection is a mirror image relative to its own wall, and none turns a different way.
pc.fail: A reflection turns the wrong way; or one is a different colour; or one is upside down.

pc.expect: The reflections do not move on their own.
pc.fail: A reflection drifts across its wall; or shifts while the balloon hangs still.

pc.expect: The walls are flat and rigid: the reflections are undistorted.
pc.fail: A wall ripples; or a reflection warps; or a wall bends.

pc.expect: One balloon and one reflection per wall.
pc.fail: A second balloon appears in the elevator; or a reflection steps out of its wall; or the balloon vanishes; or the string passes through a wall.

pc.expect: The balloon's colour and the elevator stay the same.
pc.fail: The balloon changes colour; or the walls change; or the string changes.

note: Mirror geometry: each point of the image lies directly across the mirror surface from the real point, so the image is a mirror copy, not a rotated one.
